actual_survey_support.zero_site_example: Llano Point, chinstrap, 14 seasons containing reported numeric zero; not independently validated as surveyed-patch absence

inference_limits: SCAR land feature IDs are not independent physical islands.
SCAR 2024 bare-rock mapped after GLIMS source year does not prove the rock was newly exposed during the old/new GLIMS interval.
A known MAPPPD colony site coordinate does not locate its actual nests relative to apparent GLIMS change polygons.
Original MAPPPD missing rows are not absences; original numeric zero is not survey verified whole patch absence.
Three sources do not produce a surveyed habitat risk set of empty patches, and no colonization, persistence, or climate effect is estimable.
Some colonies already have nest count records decades before the 2024 rock map (e.g. Jougla Point gentoo 1982), demonstrating that later rock mapping need not imply newly occupied colony.
next_decisive_data: Independent dated before/after land-exposure imagery, exact nest-patch georeferences and repeat surveyed non-detection plus detection from same defined risk set, replicated across physical islands.
